title: Profile target remains in mg/dL after changing units
body:
I initialized a new installation of AndroidAPS 3.4. During the setup wizard, I selected mg/dL as the glucose unit. Later, in the UI, I changed the units to mmol/L.

After changing the units, values were converted correctly, but the profile target is still displayed in mg/dL. This behavior occurs for both existing profiles and newly created profiles.

comments.body: i checked the behavior  and it works correctly. new profile takes units from setting at time of creation and it cannot be changed afterwards. switching units and creating new profile make it in new units
